_doc: Acknowledged removals of preset model ids from piBuiltinModels.generated.ts.
Removing models is normal upstream behaviour; this file exists so that a removal is SEEN.
successor-not-substitutable: a same-name successor exists, but consumers pinned to the exact id
(frozen testbeds, recorded baselines) cannot swap to it without rebuilding their comparison surface.

If the successor is NOT in this preset catalogue (it lives on the gateway/connection surface, or the vendor changed), use 'no-replacement' and say where it went in 'note'. Do NOT invent an in-catalogue id to satisfy the check: the validation exists to stop a wrong id being recorded, and inventing one to go green is the failure it is meant to prevent.

removed.note: 0.86.1 dropped the free-tier VARIANT of this model. The base id is still offered on the SAME provider (openrouter), so the model itself is still available -- what is gone is the ':free' variant. Label changes from '...0731 (free)' to '...0731', hence labelChangeAcknowledged: this is the same model id without the free tier, not a different model wearing the same name. No in-repo consumer pins the ':free' id (checked packages/ fixtures and configs). NEW in 0.86.1; separate from the 33 ids removed in 0.86.0 (#8026), tracked on task #322.
